{{Quote|A transport has already left Desolation Station with the final superlaser component, it's currently en-route to the Death Star construction site. A '''shield corridor''' was a [[Deflector shield/Legends|field of protective energy]] that was projected into a tunnel shape. [[Desolation Station/Legends|Desolation Station]] projected a shield corridor that was capable of encompassing an [[Imperial Heavy Transport|Imperial heavy transport]]. Once activated, cargo from the station was transferred to the transport via [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]]. While the shield corridor was activated, the transport inside couldn't be boarded and the transfer of cargo couldn't be disrupted. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[X2]] was only able to [[Mission to Desolation Station|hijack]] [[Desolation Station transport|an Imperial heavy transport]] once he infiltrated Desolation Station and disabled the corridor.<ref name="BF: ES" />
